name: star_rai_tripo_hairalt_v3_5_1_runtime_variant_A
note: variant A: v3.5 joints + the v3.4 tip hitRadius (back_a_05 5.1, back_b_05 8.0, back_center_05 17.5, layer_b_04 10.6 mm); everything else = the v3.5 B spring_runtime | v3.5.1: chain-link rest offsets recomputed on the v3.5 joints

spring_runtime.format: VRMC_springBone-1.0 style (proposal for CAD bones JSON); units native Tripo metres (x 1.6554 = 1.62 m world)

STAR_hairalt_chain_links.note: VRM 1.0 has no chain-to-chain constraint; runtime must apply this after the per-joint verlet + collision pass, then re-run collision and Limit Rotation per chain.
STAR_hairalt_chain_links.contact_aware: if a joint (or an ancestor in its chain) touched a collider this step, it does not move; its partner takes the full correction; if both touched, skip
STAR_hairalt_chain_links.stiffness_normalisation: stiffness = 2.0 x bone_length / median_bone_length (ahoge chain x3); dragForce 0.6
STAR_hairalt_chain_links.rest_offset_convention: R_head_rest^T @ (tail(b)-tail(a)), native m; recomputed on v3.5 joints in v3.5.1

STAR_hairalt_limits.note: per-joint local Euler clamp after the verlet step (Blender LIMIT_ROTATION limits_suggested, LOCAL space, roll 0)
